security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU implements Zfinx but does not check mstateen0.FCSR / sstateen0.FCSR / hstateen0.FCSR before executing floating-point instructions, or incorrectly routes the F-extension path (mstatus.FS check) when Zfinx is active, because the old code only checked mstatus.FS and misa.F. A QEMU build where Zfinx is advertised via ISA string or device tree but the TCG translate path still uses the legacy mstatus.FS gating would execute FP instructions that the spec mandates must raise IllegalInstruction.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: check_f_ok OR helper_check_f_ok OR REQUIRE_FPU OR require_fp OR fp_ok OR riscv_csrrw.*mstateen OR riscv_csrrw.*sstateen OR Zfinx.*translate OR trans_.*fmadd OR trans_.*fadd
security_spec.summary: check_f_ok now gates FP execution on stateen CSRs for Zfinx instead of mstatus.FS; QEMU TCG translate must switch between these two gating regimes based on implemented extensions, or a guest in a mode disabled via stateen can execute FP instructions, leaking or corrupting FPR state across privilege boundaries
